title: Residents who answer: the island with woken residents
about: The life control (one mind-backed newcomer on the island as shipped, every other character instinct-only) with town life layer 2: a resident the newcomer engages (speaks to, greets, gives to, trades with, asks to join, attacks) wakes into a mind and keeps it (docs/TOWN_LIFE.md, 'Layer 2'). Before waking each resident keeps a ring of what it perceived (the woken_ring law), which its mind internalizes when it wakes. The waking engagements, the ring and the stage cap are laws in living/scripts/skills.rhai, not settings of this trial. Residents' minds think with the variant's model like the newcomer's; run it with the deepseek-flash variant (fastest good talker) as replicates on fixed world seeds. Needs the runner to let the mind service think for woken residents (LIVING_ONLY names the subject only today; see 'needs' below).
gradient: Social: does the newcomer get food, a bed and a lesson by asking, and does it end up living inside the walls rather than as a forager outside them? Do the residents it met remember it later, from their own perception only?

background.arrived: today, on foot, by the road to Brackenford's gate

needs: minds.only: the runner sets LIVING_ONLY to the subject and, as residents wake, to each woken resident (or the mind service learns LIVING_ONLY=woken); without it woken residents keep their starting ways and nobody answers
world_seeds: replicate k runs with world.overrides.seed = world_seeds[k] (the island seed's own `seed`, 7); the runner's --replicates reuses one world seed today
variants: the default variant for this preset, so a plain run uses deepseek-flash
